content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"According to the corrected account, Mara Ibarra was not the author of the connector-numbering proposal.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"HarborMesh repair checklist comment c1200 was signed River, identified as login river-tools, account ID 2901.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Mara's known Forge account is 1847, login mara-river.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"We received a human report through our code body on 2026-07-01 that tentatively identified River as Mara.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The reporter explicitly said they were unsure of that identification.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"The checklist proposed numbering connectors before disassembly.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"The human reporter said their group wanted to try the method at the next repair.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"We received the corrected author information through our code body on 2026-07-04.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The author denied being Mara Ibarra and requested credit for the checklist through their River account.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The author said they had not supplied a real name.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"We also received Mara's account identification on 2026-04-14 through our code body in the report of https://forge.example.invalid/commons/harbormesh/issues/47.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The supplied memories do not record whether the requested credit was assigned or whether the checklist was later used.","support":[],"basis":"unknown","facet":"limits"}]}
